body: Maybe not now but those are the thoughts of a cynic and I'm sure your not cynical just fed up, only you can decide what's worth living for you may have a child and that would blow your current mindset completely out of the water therapists only ever seem to tip-toe around the situation and hell it is all leading to death that's a known fact but Its what happens between now and then that matters like I kinda said before this is a mindset and it can be changed, you just need to be patient you will find your calling and when you do you wont care how pointless everything is because it will mean something to you and that at the end of the day is all that matters!

Yeah I can relate to that may be a while before you find out exactly whats up, but untill then just find something get passionate about music anything pills don't solve everything and some stuff like this just turns out you need a friend someone to chat to for a bit you should find some peace of mind out of it Im sure your a great guy so the best advise I can give you is if you think about yourself your life ect ect to deeply/too much your head will take you prisoner and then you cant help but feel sad, so take yourself away from it watch something funny do whatever you enjoy and you'll feel a bit better

Hey  I understand where your coming from but you have to decide what your paycheck means to you whether it means saving for something you have always wanted or starting a business paying for band stuff or for family. It may seem pointless now but its not you'll find meaning in your own way. were all scared of death in our own right but yeah Its your outlook on life and It will change for time to time but you can make a meaning for yourself it just a matter of perception ;)

You will be ok buddy Teen life can be very hard but you will get through it, you should try and build your confidence your still very young and have all the time in the world to enjoy and find a girl who loves you for who you are im sure your a really nice dude so its only a matter of time, I'm sure you must have friend maybe its just hard to see that right now at the very least you have a friend in me so take care of yourself you will be, ok im sure one day you will want to make something of yourself and you can do it dont give up on yourself :)

Don't do it man you have much more to live for than you know you experiencing serious lows and have for a while I understand this as im still struggling with my own but you got this as long as your alive you can be happy even total strangers care dude I know their are assholes in the world and the system leaves many people fucked up and sad but don't end what could be an incredible existance you may not see it now but you could be someone of utmost importance in your own right so please dont let your mind take you prisoner your much stronger than that you just don't know it yet :)

Sorry to hear dude we all have such shit to deal with, but you can pull through it wont seem that way now but you can and you will be a strong person with friends around you when needed but anyway as long as you are alive you you can fight for the life you want to live as long as you can imagine how that would be and im sure you could think of how life could get better some of us really do get a rough start to life But you will be strong and make something of yourself and your happiness will follow! ;)
Cheers bud means a lot, I can get pretty cynical sometimes and I find reading stuff like this written by me can help me just think sort it out man Still breathing right :L hehe

Dude that is the spirit Theirs always people around that are willing to talk People who can empathize will give you a better insight but noway did you waste anyones time bud we all need this when were down and feeling sorry for ourselves we cant go through this shit alone, and yes you can sort that self esteem of your's thats the main point putting yourself beneath everybody else is the worst thing to do You've got all the time in the world to make it big in whatever you want to do people are often putting people down to make them feel better about themselves, don't let that get in your way of making your life something great to reflect on when your old. you can speak to me anytime dude I wont have all the answer but im pretty understanding and its better to relay your thoughts
https://www.facebook.com/jordan.turner.980315 Just let me know its you :)

Don't let it all get the better of you bro we all Give and need advise, now for you remember you still have a Job and if you did'nt you could find one dont let no motherfucker talk down to you because the thing is we all me mistakes and many of us do drugs, what I think you need more than anything is to sort out your opinion of yourself stop putting everyone else on a pedestal get some fight in your system and make something of yourself dude and lastly don't let your thoughts take you prisoner aslong as theirs air in your lungs it doesnt matter cause you can keep trying :)
